# Vanilla files the mod overrides or supplements, regenerated by sync.py from the installed game.
# Re-run sync.py after every game update, then check error.log.
#
#   blank <path>          tag-specific vanilla file with nothing for VoD: replaced by an empty file
#   sanitize <path>       copy of the vanilla file with references to removed focuses/events neutralised
#   trigger_copy <name>   vanilla scripted trigger copied verbatim into the compat file
#   trigger_stub <name>   tag-specific vanilla scripted trigger, defined as `always = no`
#   effect_copy <name>    vanilla scripted effect copied verbatim
#   effect_stub <name>    tag-specific vanilla scripted effect, defined as empty
#   dynmod_copy <name>    vanilla dynamic modifier copied verbatim
